repos.name: ORISO-Frontend
repos.summary: Frontend application for the Online-Beratung platform, covering registration, messaging, bookings, profile flows, theming, and Matrix-backed real-time communication.

repos.name: ORISO-Admin
repos.summary: Admin dashboard for the Online-Beratung platform, managing tenants, agencies, counselors, topics, invite links, global settings, user administration, and audit/log views.

repos.name: ORISO-UserService
repos.summary: Spring Boot backend responsible for user, asker, consultant, session, conversation, chat, admin, notification, deletion, and external messaging lifecycle behavior in the ORISO Online-Beratung platform.

repos.name: ORISO-AgencyService
repos.summary: Spring Boot backend for public agency lookup, agency administration, postcode ranges, topic/demographic enrichment, Matrix agency accounts, and ORISO peer-service integration.

repos.name: ORISO-ConsultingTypeService
repos.summary: Spring Boot service that owns consulting type settings, topics, topic groups, application settings, tenant-aware access, and OpenAPI contracts for the ORISO platform.

repos.name: ORISO-TenantService
repos.summary: Spring Boot service that owns ORISO tenant records, tenant settings, legal content, subdomain resolution, and tenant-specific integration with ConsultingType, ApplicationSettings, and UserAdmin services.

repos.name: ORISO-Database
repos.summary: Central ORISO database architecture and operations repository containing service-owned MariaDB schema exports, MongoDB dumps, Matrix PostgreSQL docs, Redis/RabbitMQ docs, backup artifacts, and initialization jobs.

repos.name: ORISO-Keycloak
repos.summary: Keycloak realm and deployment configuration for ORISO identity, authentication, authorization, token issuance, and IAM integration.

repos.name: ORISO-Kubernetes
repos.summary: Kubernetes infrastructure and deployment orchestration repository for the ORISO platform.
